purpose: Admission policy for the frozen core and future representation-first expansions.
core_principle: The agent or authored program constructs geometry; deterministic code only measures and admits it.

hard_gates.rule: The complete Python program must compile, execute in isolation, and emit a non-empty GDS.
Only the public primitive catalog is permitted; raw polygon dumps, device stencils, raster reads, dynamic component lookup, and private-package imports are rejected.
The model view, canonical target image, physical footprint, source program, and source evidence are hash-bound and non-blank.
Exact and D4-equivalent silhouettes are reported; exact aliases share one leakage group, and undeclared duplicates are rejected.
Declared optical ports must have finite centers, positive widths, valid orientations, and the expected side histogram; L4 evidence must come from runtime inspection.
A core-v1 rebuild is accepted only when its logical digest exactly equals the immutable release digest.

conditional_gates.rule: Repeated-element counts, branch degree, defects, and topology witnesses are required only when the grammar declares them.
Calibrated geometry and raster agreement are evidence and training signals; thresholds must be level-aware and may not erase intentional representation differences.

anti_signal_rules: Admission gates are not automatically copied into an RL reward with equal weights.
Program compilation and source purity are hard constraints, not graded aesthetic rewards.
Tiny parameter jitter is never counted as a new representation grammar.
Maximum-visibility views remain the primary supervision view; physical dimensions come from the footprint and metadata.
Rejected proposals and model repair trajectories remain outside the accepted-only core.
